annotations.title: Direct capitalization value and implied cap rate

description: Value by direct capitalization: (NOI − capital reserve) ÷ cap rate, then below-the-line deductions for lease-up costs, free-rent burn-off, and other adjustments to an as-is value (optionally rounded); and the cap rate a price implies, before and after reserves and all-in after the below-the-line costs. Records the NOI basis (trailing, forward, stabilized). Deterministic: use this instead of doing the math yourself; cite formula calc.direct_cap@1 and the returned steps, and surface any warnings.

area_sf.description: Rentable area in SF, for value per SF. Optional.

cap_rate.description: Capitalization rate as a decimal, e.g. 0.065 for 6.5%. Gives the value. Provide cap_rate, price, or both.

capex_reserve_annual.description: Annual capital (replacement) reserve deducted from NOI before capitalizing, USD/yr. 0 if the NOI is already after reserves.

free_rent_burn_off.description: Free rent still to be given under signed leases (rent the stabilized NOI assumes but the owner will not collect), USD, deducted from the capitalized value.

lease_up_costs.description: One-time costs to reach the stabilized NOI (TI, leasing commissions, lost rent during lease-up), USD, deducted from the capitalized value.

noi.description: Net operating income to capitalize, USD/yr, before capital reserves (they are deducted separately below).

noi_basis.description: What the NOI is: trailing 12 months (T-12), forward 12 months (year 1 of a pro forma), or stabilized. The cap rate must be on the same basis; this is recorded in the steps, not checked.

other_adjustments.description: Further below-the-line value adjustments, applied after capitalizing.

amount.description: USD added to the value: negative for a deduction (deferred maintenance), positive for an addition (excess land).

label.description: What the adjustment is, e.g. "deferred maintenance" or "excess land".

price.description: Purchase or asking price, USD. Gives the implied cap rate. Provide cap_rate, price, or both.

round_value_to.description: Also report the as-is value rounded to this increment (half away from zero), e.g. 100000 as appraisers round. Optional.
